ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:5 ratio of high-intensity white/light-grey pixels to low-intensity dark-grey/black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region dominated by a large contiguous dark-grey mass. High-contrast white mottling is localized on the distal tips of both lobes. A distinct vertical white linear feature is located on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated aperture of approximately 70 degrees at the central axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels across the entire trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory from the distal tips toward the median notch, with convex leading edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white pixel groups concentrated at the extreme distal tips and along segments of the trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent, near-vertical high-intensity linear mark approximately 1/3 in from the left edge of the fluke.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large vertical linear scar on the left lobe; multiple small high-contrast white focal points across the central dark pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly pronounced jagged trailing edge with deep irregular indentations across both lobes.
